bootstrap.interval: two-sided percentile95%; resample whole worlds preserving both variants and objects; same draws for all comparisons; conditional on these costs/readers, no multiplicity correction

definitions.skill: Mean of four per-axis 1-MSE/mean((GT-frozen FIT mean)^2); never Dev-centered variance.
definitions.oracle_primary: oracle_gt_y and mismatched_gt_y: dx; oracle_gt_x: dy. Full4D scores contain the supplied privileged coordinate.
definitions.direction: abs(GT dx pixels)>=1 inclusive; correct=product>0, wrong=product<0, zero=prediction==0. Non-correct=wrong+zero. GT zero and 0<abs(GT)<1 reported separately.

limits: Privileged posthoc known-Dev localization, not a deployable reader, new confirmation, or module responsibility/explained-error fraction. Nearest-grid cost rank describes this fixed surface and cannot establish descriptor information absence.

donor_y_row_match.note: World identity is mismatched; the nearest y row can coincide. Same-row predictions must be exact.
